boundaries: HealthDataNepal and Pharma-Nepal are fictional educational proposals, not documented Nepal infrastructure.
Canadian sources establish public institutional practices; they do not establish a common Oracle platform, identical schemas or confidential technical architecture.
All patient, facility, provider and transaction records in the teaching dataset are synthetic.
No legal-compliance certification is asserted. Nepal-specific production policy requires qualified legal and institutional review.
Documentation review and browser simulations do not establish execution against an Oracle instance.
